name: qa-payroll-social
description: Qatar payroll social insurance for 2026 under Law 1/2022 and its 2025 implementing regulations. Covers ordinary Qatari employees in government and private employment, the basic salary, social allowance and housing contribution base, employee and employer shares, current and grandfathered caps, sick leave, multiple employment, registration, monthly reporting, payment and penalties. Use for Qatar payroll contribution calculations, Daman employer registration, joiners, leavers, housing allowance and GCC-national employees working in Qatar. Distinguishes GCC home-country insurance from the Qatari employee calculation and routes non-GCC workers and optional self-employed enrolment separately. Includes two checked computations and primary legislation for professional review.
